events.headline: Ecuador sentences ex-president Moreno to five years in jail in bribery case

members.title: Ecuador sentences ex-president Moreno to five years in jail in bribery case
members.snippet: Lenin Moreno, 73, has also been permanently barred from holding any public office in the future.

events.headline: Nepal and China resume flood rescue as death toll surpasses 600

members.title: Nepal and China resume flood rescue as death toll surpasses 600
members.snippet: Rescue operations have resumed after a brief pause, but experts caution of danger from a newly formed lake.
